Delhi spiritual sites and temple tour

Akshardham · Lotus Temple · ISKCON · Bangla Sahib · 10 hours

10 hours New Delhi tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

One full day through the many faiths of Delhi — Akshardham, the Lotus Temple, ISKCON, Birla Mandir, Gurudwara Bangla Sahib and the Jama Masjid quarter.

At a glance

Duration
About 10 hours, 8 am to 6 pm
Transport
Private AC car
Tour type
Private
Guide
Licensed, English speaking
Pickup
Hotel or any address in Delhi NCR
Dress code
Covered shoulders and knees; heads covered at the gurudwara

What makes this one worth it

  • Akshardham's carved stone complex and gardens
  • Quiet time inside the Lotus Temple
  • ISKCON temple and the Krishna traditions behind it
  • Birla Mandir, dedicated to Vishnu and Lakshmi
  • Gurudwara Bangla Sahib and its community kitchen
  • Old Delhi and the Jama Masjid at the end of the day

Your tour schedule

  1. 8:00 AM

    Pickup

    Your driver and guide collect you from your hotel or chosen address in Delhi.

  2. 8:30 AM

    Akshardham

    The vast carved temple complex, its gardens and exhibitions, with your guide on the traditions it celebrates. Phones and bags stay in the lockers.

  3. 10:30 AM

    Lotus Temple

    The Baha'i house of worship shaped like a lotus, open to people of every faith. Time to sit in silence in the prayer hall.

  4. 12:00 PM

    ISKCON Temple

    The Krishna temple at East of Kailash — the morning devotions, the art and the stories of Krishna.

  5. 1:00 PM

    Lunch break

    Lunch at a vegetarian restaurant your guide recommends, and a short rest.

  6. 2:00 PM

    Birla Mandir

    The Laxminarayan temple, built by the Birla family and dedicated to Vishnu and Lakshmi.

  7. 3:30 PM

    Gurudwara Bangla Sahib

    Delhi's best-known Sikh shrine — the sarovar, the prayers and the langar kitchen that feeds thousands every day.

  8. 5:00 PM

    Old Delhi and Jama Masjid

    A drive into Old Delhi and time around the Jama Masjid for photographs, depending on prayer times.

  9. 6:00 PM

    Drop-off

    Back to your hotel or chosen address.

What the price covers

  • Private AC car and driver
  • Licensed English-speaking guide
  • Hotel pickup and drop
  • Bottled water
  • Parking, tolls and taxes

What it does not cover

  • Meals and drinks

  • Camera fees where charged

Questions people ask

Are there entry fees?
The temples are free to enter. Akshardham's exhibitions and water show have their own tickets, if you want them.
What should we wear?
Covered shoulders and knees. Heads are covered at the gurudwara — scarves are provided at the door.
Can we take phones into Akshardham?
No. Phones, cameras and bags go into the free lockers at the gate. Your guide will help.
Is Akshardham open every day?
It is closed on Mondays. On a Monday we swap in the Hanuman temple at Karol Bagh and Gurudwara Sis Ganj.
